requested_outcome: Every known non-place legacy page has a verified equivalent ASCII URL on VII, complete retained content, correct breadcrumbs, and a direct tested 301 only after the destination is ready; the CMS rejects Hebrew slugs and the remaining gaps are reported per legacy URL.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and the authenticated VII search-page and redirect administration surfaces
authorization_boundary: Local code, inventories, content recovery, validation and the production changes explicitly requested in this turn are authorized. No main-domain DNS cutover, unrelated place migration, legal assertion or invented content is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request requires complete family coverage and natural-destination evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every discovered legacy URL must resolve to passed evidence, a precise blocker or justified 410; live routes are checked after release.

lesson_bundle.reason: The work changes production routing and indexable pages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze one candidate, retain rollback identity and verify exact public status, Location and canonical responses.

lesson_bundle.reason: Slug, publication and redirects are managed in the CMS.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Client and server validation, persistence, audit history and public reflection are required.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is an SEO migration with pages, canonicals, sitemap and redirects.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Check status, canonical, robots, sitemap, structured breadcrumbs and redirect semantics.

lesson_bundle.reason: Breadcrumbs and URL behavior span every world and content family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Audit the shared family, not a single route example.

lesson_bundle.reason: Existing public product behavior must not regress while migration logic changes.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve place pages and unrelated approved behavior; stage only the requested files.

lesson_bundle.reason: The inventory counts and status classifications must be traceable.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Counts are reconciled to stored source rows with explicit source and timestamp.

lesson_bundle.reason: The legacy site is the approved parity reference for retained non-place content.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record title, H1, description and body parity or a documented intentional difference for each migrated page.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Some old content pages are silently omitted because only the sitemap or one export was used.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Union the legacy sitemap, stored Search Console export and existing catalog map, then classify every known source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The report reconciles every unique known source to redirect, 410, exclusion or blocker and reports source coverage.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A 301 points to a missing, generic or unrelated page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Require destination 200, self-canonical, intended content identity and no chain before enabling the redirect.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Automated complete-map validation finds zero missing destinations, chains, loops or homepage catch-alls.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Hebrew or malformed slugs can still be saved through the API even if the form cleans them.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Enforce lowercase ASCII slug validation in shared policy and server parsing, with negative tests.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Hebrew, mixed, repeated-hyphen and empty slug attempts are rejected; a valid ASCII slug saves.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Breadcrumbs look right on one world but disagree with canonical routes or schema elsewhere.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory every indexable page family and compare visible breadcrumbs, links and BreadcrumbList output.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All representative families pass link resolution and visible/schema parity checks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local build is presented as a finished migration although production still serves the old behavior.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the exact public candidate and verify the deployed routes after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The final evidence names the live version and contains direct HTTP/browser results for pages, redirects and admin validation.

affected_family: legacy sitemap and stored Search Console URL sources
public sitemap, canonical and robots output
visible breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList schema across vacations, events, spas, hourly, attractions, trails, guides, holidays, legal and static pages
authenticated search-page slug editor and server save validation
desktop and 390px mobile public page rendering

midpoint_gate.trigger: After inventory reconciliation and one migrated page plus one redirect validate end to end, before broad publication or redirect activation.
checks: destination returns 200 and redirect is direct

attack_questions: Can any known non-place legacy URL escape the report?
Can any active 301 resolve to a non-200 page, another redirect, the homepage or unrelated content?
Can Hebrew still reach a published URL through a direct API request?
Can a breadcrumb link or BreadcrumbList item disagree with the canonical route?
Does production differ from the tested candidate?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Public HTTP and browser evidence on the exact deployed VII version plus authenticated admin persistence evidence.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Machine-readable full inventory and representative browser checks for every public page family, world and mobile/desktop surface.

effectiveness.baseline: Stored inventory currently records 3,526 known legacy sources, 3,075 redirects, 451 gone entries, 2,313 migrated legacy search pages and an external requirement estimating 20,000 to 30,000 total legacy URLs; Search Console access is not verified.
effectiveness.target: Zero unclassified URLs inside the known source union, zero invalid active redirects, zero accepted non-ASCII slugs and a precise blocker list for sources unavailable without external access.
